title: Hetero-MedSAM: A Lightweight Medical Image Segmentation Framework Based on Heterogeneous Mixture of Experts and Evolutionary Pruning

detail.title: Hetero-MedSAM: A Lightweight Medical Image Segmentation Framework Based on Heterogeneous Mixture of Experts and Evolutionary Pruning
detail.abstract: Due to its substantial vision encoder, the deployment of MedSAM on edge devices is often constrained. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods typically adopt homogeneous structures, which may exhibit limited representation capabilities when encountering multi-scale targets, complex boundaries, and cross-modal variations in medical images. To address these issues, this paper presents Hetero-MedSAM, a lightweight medical segmentation framework based on a heterogeneous mixture of experts and evolutionary pruning. This approach freezes the backbone network and introduces a heterogeneous expert bank composed of scale-aware, anisotropic edge, context modulation, and modality compensation modules to assist in modeling complex features. Concurrently, an evolutionary pruning mechanism is designed to dynamically evaluate expert contributions and remove redundant branches, seeking to achieve structure-adaptive compression and mitigate inference overhead. Experimental results on multi-modal datasets indicate that Hetero-MedSAM requires only 4.40M trainable parameters and reaches an inference speed of 4.42 FPS. While maintaining a relatively low computational overhead, its segmentation performance shows favorable improvements over several lightweight variants, suggesting the potential efficacy of the proposed heterogeneous expert design and evolutionary pruning strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hetero-MedSAM，一种基于异构专家混合与进化剪枝的轻量级医学图像分割框架。通过冻结主干网络并引入异构专家库（尺度感知、各向异性边缘、上下文调制、模态补偿模块），结合进化剪枝机制动态评估专家贡献并移除冗余分支，在仅需4.40M可训练参数和4.42 FPS推理速度下，相较于多个轻量级变体取得更优分割性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在保持低计算开销的前提下，提升MedSAM在边缘设备上对医学图像中多尺度目标、复杂边界和跨模态变化的表征能力？
AI.motivation: MedSAM因视觉编码器庞大难以部署于边缘设备；现有参数高效微调方法采用同质结构，在处理医学图像中的多尺度目标、复杂边界和跨模态变化时表征能力有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异构专家混合（Heterogeneous Mixture of Experts）；进化剪枝（Evolutionary Pruning）；参数高效微调（Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning）。
AI.method: 冻结MedSAM骨干网络；构建异构专家库（尺度感知模块、各向异性边缘模块、上下文调制模块、模态补偿模块）；设计进化剪枝机制动态评估专家贡献并移除冗余分支，实现结构自适应压缩。
AI.findings: 在多种模态数据集上，Hetero-MedSAM仅需4.40M可训练参数，推理速度为4.42 FPS；在保持较低计算开销的同时，分割性能优于多个轻量级变体，验证了异构专家设计与进化剪枝策略的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出异构专家混合架构用于医学图像分割，突破了传统同质结构在表征多尺度、复杂边界和跨模态特征上的局限；引入进化剪枝机制实现结构自适应压缩，为参数高效微调提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为MedSAM在边缘设备上的部署提供了可行的轻量化方案；在极低参数量和较高推理速度下取得有竞争力的分割性能，有助于推动医学图像分割在资源受限场景中的实际应用。

title: Beyond Sentiment: Explaining Software Project Health through Communication Risk Dynamics
affiliations: Lebanese American University, Lebanese American University, Lebanese American University and Lebanese American University

detail.title: Beyond Sentiment: Explaining Software Project Health through Communication Risk Dynamics
detail.abstract: Communication-related challenges are increasingly recognized as important contributors to software project outcomes, yet software engineering research lacks a unified theoretical framework explaining how communication conditions emerge, evolve, and influence project health. This study introduces Sentiment Risk Dynamics Theory (SRDT), a novel socio-technical theory that conceptualizes communication risk as an emergent phenomenon arising from uncertainty, disagreement, escalation, sentiment dynamics, and interaction quality. Drawing upon Socio-Technical Systems Theory, Cognitive Coordination Theory, Communication Friction Theory, and Risk Signaling Theory, SRDT proposes that communication risk accumulates over time, influences coordination effectiveness, provides early warning signals of project degradation, and is amplified by communication volatility. The theory was evaluated using a large-scale empirical dataset comprising approximately 283,600 developer comments, 47,948 issues, 20,000 pull requests, and 850 project milestones collected from multiple open-source software repositories. The study introduces several communication-aware constructs, including the Communication Risk Index (CRI), Sentiment Volatility Index (SVI), Coordination Effectiveness Score (CES), and Project Health Index (PHI). Results demonstrate that communication risk strongly predicts coordination effectiveness (R² = 0.47) and project-health degradation (R² = 0.63), while sentiment volatility further amplifies these effects (R² = 0.68). Communication-aware models improved explanatory power from 0.54 to 0.68, representing a 25.9% relative improvement over technical-only models. Empirical support was observed for the Risk Accumulation, Early Warning, and Volatility Amplification theorems. The findings establish communication dynamics as an independent and measurable dimension of software project health and contribute a new theory, validated communication-risk constructs, and practical insights for communication-aware software project monitoring and risk management.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出情感风险动力学理论（SRDT），将沟通风险概念化为由不确定性、分歧、升级、情感动态和交互质量涌现的现象。基于大规模开源软件数据（约28.36万条开发者评论等）进行实证检验，证明沟通风险能强预测协调效能（R²=0.47）和项目健康退化（R²=0.63），情感波动进一步放大效应（R²=0.68），沟通感知模型比纯技术模型解释力提升25.9%。
AI.research_question: 沟通条件如何涌现、演化并影响软件项目健康？沟通风险是否可作为独立维度衡量并预测软件项目结果？
AI.motivation: 软件工程研究认识到沟通挑战对项目结果的重要影响，但缺乏统一的理论框架来解释沟通条件的涌现、演化及其对项目健康的作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 情感风险动力学理论（SRDT）：整合社会技术系统理论、认知协调理论、沟通摩擦理论和风险信号理论，提出沟通风险累积、影响协调效能、提供早期预警信号、并被沟通波动放大的核心定理。
AI.method: 大规模实证研究。数据来源：多个开源软件仓库，包含约283,600条开发者评论、47,948个议题、20,000个拉取请求、850个项目里程碑。构建沟通风险指数(CRI)、情感波动指数(SVI)、协调效能得分(CES)、项目健康指数(PHI)等沟通感知构念。
AI.findings: 1) 沟通风险强预测协调效能（R²=0.47）；2) 沟通风险强预测项目健康退化（R²=0.63）；3) 情感波动放大上述效应（R²=0.68）；4) 沟通感知模型解释力从0.54提升至0.68（相对提升25.9%）；5) 风险累积、早期预警、波动放大定理均获实证支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了情感风险动力学理论（SRDT），为软件工程沟通研究提供了统一的理论框架；建立了沟通风险作为软件项目健康独立可衡量维度的理论地位；提出了风险累积、早期预警和波动放大三个核心定理。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了沟通风险指数(CRI)、情感波动指数(SVI)、协调效能得分(CES)、项目健康指数(PHI)等可操作化测量工具；为沟通感知的软件项目监控和风险管理提供了实践洞察；相比纯技术模型实现了25.9%的解释力提升。

title: The Sovereign-Bank Nexus in Emerging Markets and Developing Economies

detail.title: The Sovereign-Bank Nexus in Emerging Markets and Developing Economies

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: As public debt in emerging markets (EMs) and low-income countries (LICs) has surged since the COVID-19 pandemic, so has the exposure of domestic banks to their sovereigns—raising concerns of destabilizing feedback loops if fiscal conditions deteriorate. This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of this sovereign-bank nexus using a new granular dataset covering over 120 EMs and LICs, combined with IMF Financial Soundness Indicators. We document a marked post-pandemic strengthening of the nexus, particularly in Sub-Saharan Africa and the Middle East and Central Asia, and show that public debt levels, deposit rates, and nonperforming loans are its most robust correlates. While we find no broad evidence of financial repression, higher sovereign refinancing needs significantly increase banks' government debt holdings in countries with substantial state-owned bank presence. Sensitivity analysis illustrates that the consequences of a strong nexus can be severe: even a moderate domestic debt restructuring could render several banking systems undercapitalized, underscoring that high reported capital ratios in strong-nexus countries may provide a false sense of security.

AI.tldr: 本文利用覆盖120多个新兴市场和发展中经济体的新数据集，系统分析了后疫情时代主权-银行关联的强化现象，发现公共债务水平、存款利率和不良贷款是最强相关因素，并警示强关联可能因国内债务重组导致银行系统资本不足，造成虚假的安全感。
AI.research_question: 后疫情时代，新兴市场和发展中经济体的主权-银行关联程度如何？哪些因素驱动了这一关联？强关联会带来怎样的金融稳定风险？
AI.motivation: 疫情后新兴市场和发展中经济体公共债务激增，国内银行对主权债务的风险敞口随之扩大，可能形成财政恶化与银行体系脆弱性之间的负反馈循环，亟需系统性的跨国实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主权-银行关联（sovereign-bank nexus）、金融压制（financial repression）、主权债务重组与银行资本充足率的交互影响。
AI.method: 利用涵盖120多个新兴市场和发展中经济体的新粒度数据集，结合IMF金融稳健性指标，进行跨国面板数据回归分析和敏感性分析。
AI.findings: (1) 后疫情时期主权-银行关联显著增强，尤其在撒哈拉以南非洲、中东和中亚地区；(2) 公共债务水平、存款利率和不良贷款率是最稳健的关联因素；(3) 未发现广泛的金融压制证据，但在国有银行占比较大的国家，较高主权再融资需求显著增加银行持有政府债务；(4) 即使温和的国内债务重组也可能使多个银行体系陷入资本不足，高资本充足率可能存在虚假安全感。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统量化了后疫情时代主权-银行关联的跨国异质性及其驱动因素，识别了国有银行渠道这一重要机制，揭示了传统资本充足率指标在强关联国家的误导性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了主权-银行关联的早期预警指标（公共债务、存款利率、不良贷款）；警示监管机构应重新评估强关联国家的银行资本充足率真实性；提示在国有银行占主导的国家需特别关注主权再融资压力向银行系统的传导风险。

title: Wage Dynamics in Europe
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and

detail.title: Wage Dynamics in Europe

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the drivers of wage growth in Europe and assesses whether the 2022–23 inflation surge has altered wage-setting dynamics, using cross-country macro evidence for 26 European economies, agreement-level collective bargaining data for Spain, and estimates of minimum and public sector wage spillovers. We find that the slope of the wage Phillips curve has not materially changed since the pandemic—labor market slack continues exerting a restraining influence on wage growth. However, postpandemic wage growth was higher than predicted by historical relationships, reflecting the outsized inflation shock and a higher sensitivity of wages to past inflation. Wage-setting is found to differ markedly across regions. In Central, Eastern, and Southeastern European Economies (CESEE), wage formation remains more backward-looking, with past inflation playing a dominant role, whereas in Advanced Economies (AEs) inflation expectations are more important. In AEs, the recent wage response followed a sequential pattern: the wage drift rose early as employers granted ad hoc increases, while negotiated wages adjusted with a lag as collective agreements were renewed and workers recouped accumulated real wage losses. Micro evidence from Spain shows that institutional features of collective bargaining conditionally amplify inflation pass-through: CPI indexation clauses, sector-level bargaining, and shorter contract duration are each associated with stronger wage responses to past inflation. In parallel, minimum wage pass-through has strengthened markedly in CESEE since 2015, while public sector wages dampened aggregate wage growth in AEs but amplified it in CESEE during 2022–24. Taken together, these findings suggest that while the core Phillips curve mechanism remains intact, future inflation shocks could generate more persistent wage pressures where wage-setting is more backward-looking, inflation compensation becomes institutionalized (including through indexation that interacts with downward nominal rigidity), or discretionary minimum and public sector wage policies add impetus.

AI.tldr: 本文利用26个欧洲国家的宏观经济数据、西班牙的集体谈判协议数据以及最低工资和公共部门工资溢出效应估计，研究了欧洲工资增长的驱动因素，特别是2022-23年通胀飙升是否改变了工资设定动态。研究发现，工资菲利普斯曲线的斜率在大流行后并未显著变化，但后疫情时代的工资增长高于历史关系预测，反映了巨大的通胀冲击和工资对过去通胀的更高敏感度。区域差异显著：中欧、东欧和东南欧经济体工资形成更向后看，而发达经济体中通胀预期更重要。微观证据显示，西班牙的集体谈判制度特征（CPI指数化条款、行业级谈判、较短合同期限）会放大通胀传导。最低工资和公共部门工资的传导效应在不同地区表现不同。
AI.research_question: 欧洲工资增长的驱动因素是什么？2022-23年通胀飙升是否改变了工资设定动态？不同欧洲地区在工资设定机制上存在哪些差异？
AI.motivation: 2022-23年欧洲经历了历史性的通胀飙升，工资增长随之显著上升。理解工资设定动态是否发生了结构性变化，对于评估未来通胀持续性和货币政策制定至关重要。不同欧洲地区（发达经济体与中欧东欧东南欧经济体）的工资设定机制差异尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工资菲利普斯曲线、通胀预期理论、集体谈判理论、工资指数化理论、最低工资传导理论、公共部门工资溢出效应理论
AI.method: 跨境宏观经济证据（26个欧洲经济体）、协议层面集体谈判数据（西班牙）、最低工资和公共部门工资溢出效应估计
AI.findings: 1. 工资菲利普斯曲线斜率大流行后未实质性改变，劳动力市场松弛仍抑制工资增长。2. 后疫情时代工资增长高于历史预测，反映通胀冲击和工资对过去通胀敏感性提高。3. 区域差异显著：CESEE工资更向后看，AE中通胀预期更重要。4. AE中工资响应呈顺序模式：工资漂移先上升，谈判工资滞后调整。5. 西班牙微观证据：CPI指数化条款、行业级谈判、短合同期限放大通胀传导。6. 最低工资传导在CESEE自2015年以来显著加强；公共部门工资在AE抑制总工资增长，在CESEE则放大增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 为工资菲利普斯曲线机制在后疫情时代的稳健性提供了经验证据；揭示了不同欧洲地区工资设定机制的异质性；阐明了集体谈判制度特征如何调节通胀对工资的传导；整合了最低工资和公共部门工资的溢出效应分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲央行和各国央行制定货币政策提供了工资-通胀动态的实证依据；提示政策制定者关注工资设定向后看程度较高的地区可能面临的通胀持续性风险；为评估集体谈判制度改革（如指数化条款、合同期限）对通胀传导的影响提供了参考；为最低工资和公共部门工资政策对整体工资增长的影响提供了量化证据。

title: Seemingly Anchored Inflation Expectations
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - Department of Economics and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Seemingly Anchored Inflation Expectations
detail.abstract: Empirical evidence commonly cited as indicating that inflation expectations have become better anchored includes the declining sensitivity of expectations to inflation surprises over time, particularly around the adoption of inflation targeting. These patterns are typically attributed to the influence of explicit or implicit inflation targets on inflation expectations. We show that this evidence is consistent with a model of experience-based learning in which individuals learn solely from their life-time history of realized inflation, without anchoring their expectations to an announced inflation target. In this model, the prolonged experience of low short-run inflation persistence in the pre-COVID decades renders long-run expectations insensitive to inflation surprises, matching the patterns observed in empirical anchoring tests. A unique prediction of the experience-based learning model is also borne out in the data: the decline in surprise sensitivity since the 1980s is strongest among younger individuals. The memory of low inflation persistence experiences further explains why long-run inflation expectations remained stable in the face of the post-COVID inflation surge. At the same time, simulations indicate that the sensitivity of long-run expectations to inflation surprises would rise sharply if individuals were to experience another sustained episode of highly persistent inflation. Overall, long-run inflation expectations may be less firmly anchored than commonly believed.

AI.tldr: 本文表明，通常被归因于通胀目标制的通胀预期锚定现象，其实可以通过个体基于亲身经历的体验式学习模型来解释，而非依赖于官方通胀目标。
AI.research_question: 通胀预期的"锚定"现象（即对通胀意外的敏感性下降）是否真的源于通胀目标制，还是可以通过个体基于过往经历的体验式学习来解释？
AI.motivation: 挑战主流观点——即通胀预期锚定归因于通胀目标制的宣告，揭示体验式学习作为替代机制的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 体验式学习（Experience-Based Learning）模型：个体仅基于其生命周期中经历的实际通胀历史来形成预期，而非参照官方公布的通胀目标。
AI.method: 理论建模与实证检验相结合，使用美国微观调查数据（如密歇根消费者调查）验证模型预测，并进行模拟分析。
AI.findings: （1）低通胀持续性环境下，长期通胀预期自然对通胀意外不敏感，与锚定假说观测模式一致；（2）1980年代以来，年轻群体对通胀意外的敏感性下降最明显；（3）低通胀持续性的记忆解释了后疫情时代通胀飙升中长期预期的稳定；（4）模拟显示，若再次经历高持续性通胀，长期预期的敏感性将急剧上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出体验式学习作为通胀预期锚定现象的新解释机制，挑战通胀目标制锚定预期的传统观点，指出长期通胀预期的锚定程度可能被高估。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示政策制定者：当前看似锚定的通胀预期可能因通胀持续性环境的改变而迅速脱锚，通胀目标制的实际锚定效果可能不如预期。
